entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Mornin'.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ooh, a uniform!
School resumes today.
Does it look weird?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Make sure you study hard.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You look great. Surprisingly.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Futaba says she's going to shift to living[n]a morning person's life.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A healthy mission starts with a healthy[n]lifestyle.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Mission?

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: ...And onto breaking news.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: In regard to the so-called "Phantom[n]Thieves" events that have been a hot[n]topic among the general public...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The prime minister held a press[n]conference at his official residence[n]to address the problem.

entries.speaker: Prime Minister
entries.en: The government acknowledges the[n]current rumors of the group called[n]the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Prime Minister
entries.en: We are currently confirming facts with[n]the police and wish to deal with it in[n]an appropriate—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Even the prime minister's talking about[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They're allies of justice, after all.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: They change hearts, huh? I wonder if[n]it's true.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we're finally being recognized[n]across the country.
You think so?
Don't overexaggerate.
Let's stay calm.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In all honesty, I think you guys are[n]managing great. It's all thanks to my[n]amazing guidance.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That humility of yours is favorable.[n]I bet you stole that from me, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even though you have ambitions, you[n]remain cool, hm? I bet you stole that[n]from me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's find clues on that case as soon[n]as we can too, and resolve it ourselves.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...For Futaba's sake too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...You two really get along, don't you?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're gonna be late if you don't[n]get going soon.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Good luck on your student duties.
